name: Alpbacher Seentour
kurzbeschreibung: The scenic Alpbacher Seentour circuit links Reintalersee, Krummsee, Frauensee, and Buchsee at the base of the Rofan mountains.
preis: Free public access; beach lidos and parking lots charge fees
oeffnungszeiten: Freely accessible year-round around the clock (bathing season May to September)
beschreibung:
Overview

The Alpbacher Seentour across the Kramsach lake plateau is one of the most delightful valley hiking circuits in the Tyrolean lowlands. Situated at the sunny base of the rugged Rofan mountains, this peaceful loop connects several pristine mountain and swimming lakes: expansive Reintalersee, tranquil Krummsee, secluded Frauensee, and small Buchsee. Thanks to their sheltered, sunny basin location, the Kramsach lakes are considered the warmest swimming lakes in Tyrol, with summer water temperatures reaching up to 25 degrees Celsius. Rolling forested hills, reed beds, flowering wetlands, and the limestone walls of Rofan form a scenic harmony that enchants holidaymakers, nature lovers, and active families alike.

Route & Requirements

This scenic lake circuit covers approximately ten kilometers with a gentle 150 meters of elevation change, taking about 2.5 to 3 hours of walking time. The trail runs primarily along flat shoreline promenades, wide gravel paths, and shaded woodland trails with no technical difficulties. The loop around Reintalersee is largely flat and barrier-free, making it easily manageable with strollers or for senior walkers. Comfortable sports shoes or lightweight walking shoes with profiled soles are perfectly sufficient for the full route. Numerous resting benches, viewing platforms, and sunbathing lawns along the way invite visitors to take relaxing breaks. Interpretive boards provide facts about the ice-age formation of the lake plateau and protected local wildlife. Dogs are welcome on hiking paths but not allowed in designated swimming lidos. Cozy lakeside restaurants and cafes offer refreshments along the shores.

Visit & Arrival

The walking trail is accessible year-round free of charge; the best hiking season spans from April to November, with sunny summer months offering warm swimming waters. Motorists reach the lakes via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Kramsach) and follow signs toward Kramsach/Seen to designated parking areas at Reintalersee (parking fees apply). By train, travel to Brixlegg or Rattenberg-Kramsach station, where VVT bus lines 605 and 606 run regularly to lakeshore bus stops.

Tips

Pack swimwear in summer to enjoy a refreshing swim at the lakeside lawns of Reintalersee. Stop by the traditional restaurant "Fischerstube" right on the water and savor freshly caught trout or a hearty Tyrolean snack platter on the sunny lakeside terrace.
